title: Rav Yehudah of Sura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bava Batra 89a records his valuable exposition of the verse: “You shall not have in your house”—why? Because of “ephah and ephah.” “You shall not have in your pouch”—why? Because of “stone and stone.” But “a whole and just stone” (then) “you shall have.” Hyman cites Niddah 27a for the scriptural proof that the Levites kept watch at twenty-one places. Hyman infers from the passage that Rav Yehuda preceded Abaye.

notes.text: The guard-post passage occurs in the checked Tamid 27a; Hyman’s supplied citation says Niddah 27a. The number twenty-one and his chronological inference are preserved.

No new primary scalar was returned. The earlier recorded matching guard-post discussion is in Tamid 27a, beside supplied Niddah 27a; this is inherited consultation, not fresh inspection. כ״א is twenty-one, not the older note’s unrelated בל״א. Both house/ephah and pouch/stone clauses, the repeated words and Hyman’s parenthetical THEN are preserved. His conclusion that the sage preceded Abaye remains an inference, not a fixed chronological identification. The added Deuteronomy verse labels in an older English are editorial aids, not supplied Hebrew locators.

The printed notice (vol. II, p. 616) gives Niddah 27a, twenty-one, and the parenthetical “then.” Bava Batra 89a gives the house and pouch clauses and goes on to quote the just measure. The matching guard-post discussion is in Tamid 27a. It attributes the proof either to Rav Yehuda of Sura or to a baraita. Abaye then answers an objection to the count. Hyman infers the relative chronology from this passage.
